rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all tickers, prices, and numerical data.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-[10px] or text-xs), and wide spacing (tracking-[0.1em]).
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Card padding should be consistent (p-4 or p-5).
Grid Borders strategy: expose the skeleton with 1px borders.

header.style: solid background with hard bottom border

buttons.primary: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-[#0056b3] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.buy: bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759] border border-[#34C759]/30 hover:bg-[#34C759]/20 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm uppercase
buttons.sell: bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] border border-[#FF3B30]/30 hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/20 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm uppercase

rules: Use area charts for PnL with gradient fill (green or red based on value).
Hide excessive grid lines; use very subtle horizontal grid lines (stroke #222222).
Tooltip must match the tactical dark theme.

tables.header: text-xs uppercase text-[#A0A0A0] border-b border-[#222222] bg-[#0A0A0A]

badges.buy: bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759] border border-[#34C759]/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono uppercase
badges.sell: bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] border border-[#FF3B30]/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono uppercase
badges.neutral: bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF] border border-[#007AFF]/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono uppercase

forms.input: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#222222] text-white rounded-md focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF] transition-all font-mono text-sm
forms.label: text-xs uppercase text-[#A0A0A0] tracking-wider mb-1 block

rules: Don't use filled icons, keep them outlined for a technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a tactical, dark-mode 'Terminal' dashboard for algorithmic trading.
Data density is paramount. Avoid excessive white space inside cards.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layout wrappers, and Shadcn UI strictly for interactive components (dropdowns, dialogs, toasts).
Heavily customize Shadcn to remove generic Vercel look (change border radii to rounded-md, borders to #222222).
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data, symbols, and tickers.
For PnL and trade direction, strictly use the defined Buy (#34C759) and Sell (#FF3B30) colors.
Include data-testid attributes on all buttons, forms, and key metric displays.
Implement Recharts for the PnL chart with a subtle gradient area chart, no thick lines.
The sidebar or top nav should be extremely minimalistic, relying on Lucide icons.
